_description: Rendered SQL of the typed-slot and keyed catalogue statements. The JS reference renderer (tools/codegen/codegen-keystats-queries.cjs) and the Lua renderer of both drivers must produce exactly these texts; the values hold what the slot encoder must protect: quotes, a carriage return, a NUL, a line feed. A missing or null value is a missing slot.
